name: Mojang profile API
tier_rationale: Mojang AB, a Microsoft subsidiary with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P116 FC9 lists Microsoft (Mojang) as trusted.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

profile_api.title: Mojang username -> profile API (api.mojang.com/users/profiles/minecraft/{username})

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

profile_api.notes: Research C0281: 404 with 'Couldn't find any profile with name' = ABSENT (the former 204 answer too); ~600 requests per 10 minutes (community-reported). The session server (skins/capes) gives no identity-raising field and is not used. The name-history endpoint was removed by Mojang in 2022; NameMC (Cloudflare-gated) stays a manual link.
